list.name: Runtime Layer
list.description: Core C/C++ runtime implementation including garbage collection, JIT compilation, type system, method dispatch, threading, and platform abstraction

list.name: Compiler Layer
list.description: Julia compiler implementation (Compiler.jl) written in Julia - type inference, optimization, SSA IR, effects system

list.name: Frontend Layer
list.description: Parser (JuliaSyntax) and AST lowering (JuliaLowering) - transforms source code to Core.IR

list.name: Base Library Layer
list.description: Core standard library loaded at startup - fundamental types, collections, I/O, math, runtime internals

list.name: Standard Library Layer
list.description: Independently loadable standard library packages - math, system interfaces, developer tools, JLL wrappers

list.name: CLI/Entry Point Layer
list.description: Command-line interface, dynamic library loader, and platform-specific entry points

list.name: Build/Infrastructure Layer
list.description: Build system, external dependencies, patches, and contributed scripts

list.name: Documentation Layer
list.description: User manual, developer documentation, and docstrings

list.name: Test Layer
list.description: Test suites for runtime, compiler, base, stdlib, and frontend
